name: 覃鑫富
objective:
導論、積體電路生產介紹、半導體基礎、晶圓製造、加熱製程、微影蝕刻、電漿的基礎原理、離子佈植、化學氣相沉積與介電質薄膜、金屬化製程、化學機械研磨、製程整合、CMOS 製程
Introduction、Introduction to IC Fabrication、Semiconductor Basics、 Wafer Manufacturing、Thermal Processes、Photolithography and Etch、 Plasma Basics、Ion Implantation、CVD and Dielectric Thin Film、 Metallization、CMP 、Process Integration、CMOS Processes
schedule: The teacher expects each chapter to be finished weekly.
materials:
1. Introduction To Semiconductor Manufacturing Processes Fourth Edition Li Kejun Li Kehui Li Mingku
2. K. N. Tu, Hung-Ming Chen, Chih Chen. Electronic Packaging, Science and Engineering, Wiley 2021.
consultation: Students might have access to curricular consultation from the advisor to get advice about courses or academic planning.
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
